desc:
Republished Version of World Random Play Dance

🤔 Guess the Songs' Title and Dance 💃🏻🕺🏽 to the World's Famous Songs!

Move ⬇️ after the beep to guess/answer.

Game has two modes. Click the "bagpack" 🎒icon to switch modes

Mode1: "Easy Mode" (Multiple Choices to choose from while guessing the song titles) gives lesser Exp & Coins
Mode2: "Default/Hard Mode" (Manually type in the songs' name) gives more Exp & Coins

We regularly add songs. Kindly join our socials for requests and reports. Thank you so much!

BEST Music guessing game EVER
